confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on crowd-sourced averages from pages mostly dated 2023 or earlier, and sources disagree by roughly 2x. Cocktail and wine anchors are weak: no cocktail price was found, so cocktail is set from the local beer price, and wine comes from retail bottle prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the regional context, not from inspected listings. The FX observation is from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page; the 2026-11-19 figure was not used because it may not yet be published at the generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Egyptian Red Sea resort pricing (for example Sharm El Sheikh) and the tourist-facing price levels reported for Hurghada, with accommodation based on general knowledge of budget and mid-market Egyptian resort-town rates.
